description: Use when: can I sell this BNB Smart Chain token, and what is the buy/sell tax? Can you actually sell this BNB Smart Chain token? Simulates a small buy and a sell back into its deepest WBNB pool (PancakeSwap V2/V3) with an eth_call, so nothing trades. Returns sellable yes/no, buy tax %, sell tax %, the pool used, a verdict (sellable, taxed, high tax, honeypot) and coverage notes. No pool, not a token or an inconclusive simulation is not charged. Costs $0.01.
name: bsc_honeypot_check
